Summary: Smart intake at work order approval
Description: One request form, opened from the approved Fieldglass work order, that collects everything onboarding needs up front

Summary: Pre-fill intake from the Fieldglass work order
Description: As a hiring manager, I want the intake form pre-filled from the work order so that I only enter what's missing
Acceptance Criteria: Given an approved work order, when I open the intake, then worker name, dates, cost centre, site and supplier are filled and read-only; changes go back through Fieldglass

Description: As HR Ops, I want role-specific required fields (apps, equipment, building) so that tasks aren't held waiting for information
Acceptance Criteria: Given a role type, the form requires its fields; submission is blocked until they're complete; field list is configurable without code

Summary: Validate cost centre and manager at submission
Description: As HR Ops, I want cost centre and manager checked against Employee Central when the form is submitted
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid cost centre or inactive manager shows an inline error naming the fix; no EC record is created until valid

Description: One view of every onboarding task for a contractor, for the hiring manager, the supplier and HR Ops
As a hiring manager, I want to see which onboarding tasks are done, late or blocked so that I know if my contractor can start
Acceptance Criteria: Shows each task, owner and due date; red if due date is past or after the start date; refreshes from ServiceNow tasks

Description: As a supplier contact, I want to see what my worker still needs to provide (ID, forms) without emailing HR
Acceptance Criteria: Supplier sees only their workers and only the tasks assigned to the worker; no internal task details

Description: As HR Ops, I want an alert 5 business days before start when tasks are still open
Acceptance Criteria: Alert lists the open tasks and owners; goes to HR Ops and the hiring manager; one alert per worker per day

Description: End of work order drives account disable and equipment return without a manual ticket

Summary: Disable access on work order end
Description: As IAM, I want contractor accounts disabled on the work order end date unless an extension arrived
Acceptance Criteria: Account disabled at 23:59 local on end date; extension received before then cancels; audit entry written

Description: As internal audit, I want a daily check of Fieldglass vs. EC vs. ServiceNow so that mismatches are found in days, not at year-end
Acceptance Criteria: Runs daily; each exception creates a task for its owner; Critical items page the IAM on-call

Description: As the product owner, I want the funnel from work order approved to day-one ready, by supplier and role
Acceptance Criteria: Shows median days per step, % ready by start date, % needing follow-up; filterable by supplier, role, site

Description: As the product owner, I want hiring managers randomly assigned to the new or old intake so that we can measure the effect
Acceptance Criteria: Assignment is by hiring manager (not by request), stored on the request, stable for the test period
